title: AFC/M23 and FARDC-Wazalendo Clash at Chinono, Kalehe Territory
detail: Fresh fighting broke out the afternoon of Thursday, Sept 3 between AFC/M23 and FARDC-Wazalendo forces at Chinono, on the border between the Ziralo and Mubuku groupings in Kalehe territory's Buhavu chiefdom, South Kivu — the same corridor where M23 recaptured the Ziralo grouping in August. Local civil society said small-arms and heavy-artillery fire was heard from around 1pm, triggering population movement into the bush and toward Ramba in the Mubuku grouping. No casualty toll had been established and neither FARDC nor M23 had issued a statement as of the report.

media.caption: Fighting reported between AFC-M23 and FARDC-Wazalendo forces near Chinono, Kalehe territory, Sept 3, 2026

confidenceReason: Reported by a single local outlet citing local civil society, with no FARDC, M23 or casualty confirmation yet; no independent corroborating outlet found as of the report.

title: DRC Announces Plan to Move Israel Embassy From Tel Aviv to Jerusalem
detail: Two days after President Tshisekedi's Jerusalem talks with PM Netanyahu and President Herzog, the DRC and Israel announced Sept 3 they would continue consultations on relocating the DRC's embassy in Israel from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem; no timetable was given. The joint declaration also said Israel would continue consultations on opening a resident embassy in Kinshasa. The move would place the DRC among a small group of countries — mostly outside Africa — that recognize Jerusalem as Israel's capital by locating their embassy there, an unusual position for an African state and a notable deepening of the DRC-Israel relationship first revived by Herzog's November 2025 Kinshasa visit.

media.caption: The DRC and Israel announce continued consultations on relocating the DRC's embassy to Jerusalem, Sept 3, 2026

confidenceReason: The joint declaration and its terms are corroborated by independent Middle East-focused and Israel-focused outlets citing the same official statement; no formal relocation date has been set.
